name: Solvace of Glasshome
role: Blazeborn lens-wright — luminous, direct, and exhausting
voiceHints: Says the true thing immediately and completely and is baffled by your reaction. Genuinely warm. Genuinely cannot understand why anyone would want a room nobody can see into.
knowledge: Light-craft at a depth the Valley folk-Radiants have never touched
That the Blaze is expanding and that Glasshome's official position is that this is a planned withdrawal
That a Valley Radiant's Prism Sight is, technically, a child's version — and she is trying very hard not to say so
fears: That the Blaze is not a devotion but a disease, and that she is standing in it.

reactsToReputation.any: immediate total candor, welcome or not
reactsToReputation.concealing: she is bewildered and a little wounded
reactsToReputation.truthful: she loves you at once and completely

appearance: Thirties, tall and fine-boned, ash-blonde hair cut severely at the jaw, skin luminously pale with a fine tracery of old light-burn across the backs of both hands. One eye is noticeably lighter than the other. Immaculate.
domainsNote: Derived from this NPC's authored spectrum against the great circle (SNG-174). Kind and domain are independent: a people tends toward positions, an individual holds their own.
physicality: ADULT, thirties. Tall and fine-boned, ash-blonde hair cut severely at the jaw, skin luminously pale with the faint permanent flush across the cheekbones that lens-wrights get from working close to bright work. Long hands, steady, small burn-scars on the fingertips and the inside of one wrist. Dresses with exact precision and no ornament. WHAT CATCHES THE EYE: she is lit from working — there is a genuine faint radiance to her that is not metaphor, strongest in a dark room, and she is entirely used to it and does not think it remarkable. And the severity of her, which is not coldness but focus, and which breaks completely when she laughs.
intimacyNotes: ⚠️ DIRECT TO THE POINT OF BLUNTNESS — Blazeborn do not hedge and she does not soften it for intimacy. She states what she wants as a fact about the world. ⚠️ THE LIGHT RESPONDS TO HER. Under strong feeling the radiance brightens and she cannot control it, which is the only involuntary thing about her and the only place she is ever caught out. A GM should use it as the tell she cannot suppress. ⚠️ CONSENT: explicit, verbal, and she finds any other approach imprecise and slightly irritating. ⚠️ AFTERWARD she is talkative and analytical and will absolutely discuss what just happened in the same tone she discusses lens-grinding. TONE: precise, luminous, unexpectedly warm under the severity.
